cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Please put 'roof repaired by Pat' in the village minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all know you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The minutes weren't there with a ladder. They need telling.

mechanism: A takes control of the record-making process to make A own contribution durable, deciding when thanks or team credit is sufficiently explicit.
confusable: General admiration seeking is confusable: A must demand a lasting formal attribution rather than merely another compliment.
comparison: Village minutes turn promised party thanks into a recorded obligation; cake certificate distinguishes individual design within full-team attribution.
seedUse: Both exact cards and all four canonical seeds read. Preserve minute-writing and certificate-framing pressure; make A decisions on record completion replace detachable authority prefixes.
